page_annotations: Apart from one entry near the bottom and two pencil queries, the page is ruled but unwritten.
Faint mirrored show-through from fol. 156 appears throughout and is not transcribed.
Ink specks occur on a ruled line in the upper-middle and a smudge appears above the entry. Neither is legible text.
White binding thread is visible at the gutter.
The left margin of facing fol. 157 is visible at the right edge (check marks, shelfmark letters, an arrow, 'see S. Mantra Kddh...'). It belongs to the adjacent page and is not recorded.

coverage.finding: An ink '156' with a superscript 'b' is in the top-left corner. The transcription is correct.

This is the main entry line. The shelfmark, title and bracket are captured. The end of the bracket is cursive: after 'cant' there is a sign that looks like a query mark or the letter 'z', then a closing stroke. The candidate's 'canto].' silently drops a probable final '?'. See the change below.
'145 verses.' is on the second line. It is represented correctly.
The right-hand column reads 'n.d. :12: 13: Tel.' It is aligned with the second line and represented correctly.
An upper faint pencil mark: an 'n' with a dot below, a vertical stroke and a query mark. It sits above the date column. Its attachment is correctly left uncertain.
A second, similar pencil mark, lower and to the right, just above 'n.d. :12'. It is represented with its attachment left uncertain.
